knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Welcome to mydentist, Townsend House, Thetford. Along with the full range of NHS dental services, you'll find a great selection of private and cosmetic treatments, including tooth whitening, dentures and clear aligner teeth straightening. The practice also offers myoptions, which is unique to mydentist. Whether you want a check-up, an urgent appointment, treatment or even a complete smile makeover, myoptions can provide this at an affordable price. The practice is easily reached by car and car parking is available at the rear of the building. We are currently accepting new patients, so why not get in touch with us by phone or email now to see how we can help you. We look forward to welcoming you."
